# Lastelle AI

> Lastelle AI Corporation is an artisanal AI workshop building agentic AI systems and AI-embedded hardware from human craft and machine intelligence. It was founded by Damien Rosecraft.

Motto: Caelvm svspice stellis dvcibvs (Latin: "Look to the heavens, with the stars as your guide")

Source: https://lastelle.ai/
Last updated: 2026-11-14

## Intelligence synthesized by humans

Lastelle AI is an artisanal AI workshop, synthesizing agentic AI systems and AI-embedded hardware from human craft and machine intelligence.

## Products

Works in progress at the bench

### Agentic AI

Autonomous multi-agent systems for research, analysis, market intelligence and data operations.

### Hardware

AI-embedded hardware with on-device inference for robotics and autonomous systems.

## Mission

For the acceleration of the human project

Lastelle AI synthesizes solutions at the confluence of human judgment and machine intelligence, where intuition and conviction lend direction to computation on a scale no single mind could hold. Each system is composed with the deliberation of the workshop and carried out with the reach of the frontier, so that what leaves the bench extends what people are able to build, understand, and become.

Lastelle's long-term roadmap extends to robotics and unmanned systems for terrestrial and orbital applications.

## About

Lastelle AI Corporation was founded by Damien Rosecraft, a technologist since 2016 who designs and builds Lastelle's systems

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/thirdechelon

## FAQ

### What does Lastelle AI build?

Lastelle AI designs and builds agentic AI systems and AI-embedded hardware.

### What is agentic AI?

An agent is autonomous software that acts on behalf of a person, team or enterprise. Agentic AI is one or more large language model agents acting autonomously in that role.

### Does Lastelle AI take client work?

Lastelle builds its own products. Partnership inquiries are welcome.

### What technology are the systems built on?

State-of-the-art solutions from the frontier.

### How quickly will I hear back?

Typically within two business days.
